pwa.installTitle: Add EEGAI to your home screen
pwa.installBody: It opens like an app, and what you've seen stays readable offline.
pwa.iosStep1: Tap the share button in the browser bar
pwa.iosStep2: Scroll down and choose "Add to Home Screen"
pwa.installed: You're all set. EEGAI is on your home screen.
pwa.offline: You're offline. You can still look at what you've already opened.
styleguide.title: Style guide
styleguide.subtitle: Throwaway route. Delete once the wall is built.
app.subtagline: Give what you no longer need to someone in Coimbatore who does.
error.boundaryBody: Nothing you posted is lost. Reload and it will most likely work.
landing.heroLede: Give blood, hair or breast milk to a verified hospital near you — or pass on the things you no longer need.
landing.laneHealthBody: A verified hospital, blood centre or milk bank near you says what it needs. If you can help, you say so and go there yourself. We only make the introduction.
landing.laneGoodsBody: Post it from your phone. A verified organisation claims it, and a volunteer collects it from your door.
landing.gatesTitle: We ask before anything goes up
landing.gatesBody: A few honest questions about condition, answered before you post. An organisation has to sort whatever arrives, and a torn shirt costs them more to throw away than it was worth to send.
landing.forDonorBody: Give blood, hair or milk at a hospital near you — or post the things you no longer need.
landing.forNgoBody: Ask the donors near you for what you need, or claim what has been posted nearby.
landing.forVolunteerBody: Collect from a door near you and hand it over. Two codes, spoken aloud.
landing.trustOtp: A spoken code at both ends
landing.closing: No money changes hands. Nothing is sold. Nobody is ranked.
landing.step1Body: Blood, hair or breast milk, and the area you are in. Nothing else.
landing.step2Body: Only hospitals, blood centres and milk banks we have checked, and only within about 10 km of you.
landing.step3Body: You get the address and a number to ring. The donation happens there, with them.
landing.goodsHowTitle: And for the things you no longer need
landing.goodsStep1: Photograph it — one minute, from your phone.
landing.goodsStep2: A verified organisation nearby claims it.
landing.goodsStep3: A vetted volunteer collects it from your door, or a courier does.
auth.roleDonorHint: Post items you no longer need.
auth.roleNgoHint: Claim items for the people you serve.
auth.forgotBody: Tell us your number and someone will call you to set a new one. We cannot send it by message yet.
auth.forgotSent: If that number has an account, someone will call you to reset it.
